profile.headline: Software Developer at Remitly
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer having multiple years of experience in software development and data science. I have worked across different industries like consulting, finance and retail.  I have touched so many different roles in my careers such as Data scientist, Data engineer, and software engineer. 

I like to learn new things and put them to use.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led the implementation of a cheque return automation process in Elixir ultimately saving 30 min of dev time every day
• Wrote technical design documents to update  Brex’s accounting reports and implemented through our internal tooling built in python
• Worked on external asks such as modifying existing API to unblock local currency wire project
• Contributed to the implementation of Counterparty service using Kotlin, and gRPC and wrote the production runbook
• Developed and maintained internal tooling in Retool to help the CashOps team perform their everyday duties
• Resolved monthly statement generation incident that had a 100% customer impact and SLA violations during my on-call rotation
• Created a monitoring dashboard through Datadog to track Counterparty service API latency and maintain our service SLAs

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Led the design and implementation of multiple data analysis skills and product features using python, react, JavaScript and Redux
• Developed the highest revenue-generating skills which automated market share analysis in the CPG industry
• Led a team of two junior developers to spearhead our data analysis deliverables such as delivering a new KPI analysis skill for a client
• Collaborated with the engineering team to build the backend APIs for end-to-end product experience

positions.title: Co-Founder and  Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
- Built AI-powered technology to change the way real estate is bought and sold on askmilo.io
- Led a team of three as CTO to develop frontend and backend of the platform to deliver MVP
- Designed the data models and architecture of the react app

positions.title: Software Engineer - Data
positions.description:
- Led a project to develop distributed scikit-learn machine learning training on the Spark cluster using pyspark and ml-flow
- Optimized an existing pyspark application that helped the team to save $250K per year
- Developed feature engineering framework in python to generate features for data scientists
- Refactored and documented legacy codebase to increase performance and reduce code redundancy

positions.title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Built classi�cation models to identify consumers who are more likely to respond to a marketing campaign with 5% lift in revenue
- Converted data exploration and machine learning code from SAS and Python to R for production
- Supply chain analytics and reporting for a big tire company in Tableau and Alteryx 
- Designed robust ETL pipelines to preprocess data for machine learning modeling
- Deployed 34 advanced tableau dashboards for Sales, Marketing and Executive Reporting

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: - Managed a class of 20 students enrolled in Introduction to Spark and Hadoop Framework

positions.title: Data Scientist Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the team to develop 250 nodes Hadoop and HBase data lake 
- Designed data pipeline to process and store real-time data using Kafka, Spark, and Cassandra
- Implemented real-time twitter sentiment visualization using Kibana and Spark Streaming

projects.title: Real-time credit card default payment Prediction in Spark (Scala)
projects.description:
- Process streaming data using socketTextstream in real time using Spark.
- Perform data manipulation and convert data to appropriate form for machine learning algorithm.
- Use logistic regression stochastic gradient decent to predict the output label.
- Update existing model with new data.

projects.title: FitBit Analytics in R
projects.description:
-  Accessed fitbit tracker data such as steps, calories burned, sleep hours etc. using fitbit API
-  Explored fitness data using dplyr, ggplot to find interesting insights and patterns in the data
-  Created interactive plots using plotly to illustrate hidden trends and deployed application using shiny server
- Calculated Body Mass Index to show where an individual stands
